key_insight: Large-learning-rate SGD can achieve accelerated O(T^-2) convergence for cross-entropy loss with linear predictors and two-layer neural networks, despite stochastic gradient noise.
engineering_relevance: The results motivate exploring suitably chosen large learning rates rather than treating classical curvature-based stability limits as absolute tuning constraints.
method: Analyze stochastic optimization trajectories under large stepsizes.
Establish accelerated convergence for linear predictors and two-layer neural networks.
Derive tighter stable-regime guarantees, including improvements for deterministic optimization.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence guarantees and numerical experiments demonstrating practical benefits, but provides no datasets or quantitative experimental comparisons.
watch_item: The guarantees concern specific model classes and cross-entropy loss; the abstract does not specify the assumptions or stepsize-selection rules needed for implementation.
paper_title: SGD with Large Learning Rates: General Analysis & Improved Rates
